evidence: The council made reporting easier by smartphone and launched the Love Clean Streets app for residents to report straight to its contractor; recorded incidents rose from 12,170 (2017/18) to 25,765 (2018/19)

A 2024 scrutiny report says the Defra figure counts public reports only while street cleansing logs far more proactive finds; the fall from 75,614 (2016/17) to 3,900 (2017/18) fits a switch from all incidents to public reports only (switch date not stated)
The council put a 2018 rise down to improved reporting by the public; a later council paper says reports rise when reporting systems improve (no channel or date named)
A new Veolia street cleaning contract started in April 2017 and the council partnered with FixMyStreet after a September 2017 motion asking for better online reporting
A new environmental enforcement team started in August 2021; nothing published links a recording change to the step
